ambient_events: The concierge murmurs into a discreet headset and nods you through with a practiced half-smile.
Somewhere above, the elevator settles with a sound like a held breath.
description: A double-height atrium of pale stone and warm brass, floored in a river of book-matched marble that no one is allowed to scuff. A living wall of ferns breathes along one side; a concierge station of dark walnut anchors the other, always attended. Light pools from hidden coves, and the street noise dies the instant the revolving door seals behind you. A single elevator, its doors a sheet of mirror-bronze, waits at the far end. The way out is south, to the street; step in to the elevator.
name: Grand Lobby
